infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: IFCDC Barbers uses your photo library so barbers can upload haircut style photos, profile images, and gallery photos that customers can view when booking appointments.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: IFCDC Barbers saves photos you choose to upload for your profile or barber style gallery.
infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: IFCDC Barbers uses the microphone only if you choose to use voice features with AURA or speak appointment details.
infoPlist.NSSpeechRecognitionUsageDescription: IFCDC Barbers uses speech recognition only if you choose to use voice features with AURA, so the app can understand spoken appointment or service requests.
